title: Allowance Rate Table for Late-Posted Refund Credits — Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
**Allowance rate.** The late-posting allowance on a return credit to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account accrues at the allowance rate, which turns on the account's tier and on the full months it has been open since its opening date.

| Account | Full months open | Allowance rate |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred or Card Premier | 60 or more | the account's purchase APR, as the interest rate schedule shows for its tier |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred or Card Premier | at least 24 but fewer than 60 | 12 percent a year |
| every other account: Card Classic, any Ridgeline Project Loan, or a Preferred or Premier card open fewer than 24 full months | any | 6 percent a year |

**Where the rate acts.** The interest part of the late-posting allowance is the uncredited refund multiplied by the allowance rate divided by 100 and by the late-posting days, divided by 365 and rounded to the nearest cent.

**Full months open.** Counted from the opening date: an account opened on 10 March 2021 has 59 full months on 9 March 2026 and 60 full months on 10 March 2026.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Tier | Opened | Today | Full months | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Card Premier | 10 March 2021 | 10 March 2026 | 60 | Premier purchase APR |
| Card Premier | 10 March 2021 | 9 March 2026 | 59 | 12 percent |
| Card Preferred | 10 March 2024 | 10 March 2026 | 24 | 12 percent |
| Card Preferred | 10 March 2024 | 9 March 2026 | 23 | 6 percent |
| Card Classic | 10 March 2016 | 10 March 2026 | 120 | 6 percent |

## Hypothetical interest parts (uncredited refund 1000.00, 30 late-posting days)

| Rate | Interest part |
|---|---|
| 26.99 percent | 1000.00 multiplied by 26.99, divided by 100, multiplied by 30, divided by 365: 22.18 |
| 12 percent | 9.86 |
| 6 percent | 4.93 |
